ComponentRef.description: A component's id (a number) or its name.

OccurrencePath.description: An exact placement path: 1 to 64 occurrence ids from the root down.

OccurrenceRef.description: An occurrence's id (a number) or its name.

PlacementPath.description: An exact placement path: up to 64 occurrence ids from the root down; empty for the design itself.

Point3.description: A point in mm: [x, y, z] or {"x", "y", "z"}.

input.description:
Place a component again (Paste as an instance): a new occurrence of the same component, which
shares its contents, at the selected placement's transform (pending moves included) moved by
`translate`. Give the `occurrence` to copy, or the `component`.

component.description:
The component to place again, by id or name: its first placement is copied. Read only
without `occurrence`.

in_place.description:
`false`: the copy has the selected transform within its parent. `true`: it sits where the
selected placement is in the world, and `translate` is along the world axes. Default:
`false`.

occurrence.description: The placement to copy, by id or name. When given, `component` is not read.

parent.description: The component the copy goes in, by id or name. Default: the copied placement's parent.

parent_path.description:
With `in_place: true`: the placement of `parent` to place the copy by, as occurrence ids
from the top (up to 64; none is the design). A parent placed more than once puts the copy
in every instance. Default: the parent's only placement, else the active one. Read only
with `in_place: true`.

path.description:
The placement's exact path, as occurrence ids from the top of the design (1 to 64),
ending in the placement copied. Needed for a placement inside a component placed more
than once, with `in_place`.

translate.description: Move the copy by this much, in mm (up to 1e9). Default: no move.

input.title: CopyParams

label: Paste (Instance)

component.description: The component it places, by id.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

params: component (or occurrence): what to place again; path?: validates selected occurrence; parent?: component (default: the same parent); translate?: [x,y,z]; in_place?: bool (default false: the selected transform within the parent; true: where the selected placement is in the world, translate in world axes; a parent placed more than once is placed by parent_path?, else the active placement, and every instance gets the copy). Copies the selected effective transform, including pending moves
